request.style: English, male solo voice, warm and steady, acoustic guitar, cello, soft percussion, folk, 85 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Meshelemiah’s lineage clear
Firstborn Zechariah stands here
Jediael is the second name
Zebadiah takes the third claim
Jathniel the fourth in line
Levitical gatekeepers shine

[Chorus]
Standing at the door so wide
Serving at the Lord’s house inside
Guarding the threshold with care
David’s era, faithful share

[Verse]
With Jaaziel and others there
In the watch service, the prayer
Temple gates they keep secure
In their duty, in their cure
Levitical blood runs strong
Singing the songs that are sung

[Chorus]
Standing at the door so wide
Serving at the Lord’s house inside
Guarding the threshold with care
David’s era, faithful share

[Bridge]
Names written in the scroll
Guardians of the holy role
Zechariah leads the way
In the light of the day

[Outro]
Firstborn son, standing firm
Serving the Lord, keeping the arm
